name: Scott Shaw
biography: Scott Shaw is an American author, actor, filmmaker, composer, artist, journalist, photographer, and blogger. He is also a Seminar, College, and University Instructor. During his youth Shaw became involved with two primary elements that have come to define much of his life. The first was the Martial Arts and the second was Eastern Mysticism.
